China has put forward a four-point proposal on how major powers should interact with one another, Chinese President Xi Jinping announced. "First, adhere to the principle of mutual respect. Second, adhere to the principle of peaceful coexistence," Xi Jinping stated during a trilateral meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin and US leader Donald Trump, held in the city of Shenzhen on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit. The Chinese leader further specified that the third point is to "adhere to the principle of cooperation and mutually beneficial development." And, finally, the fourth point is to "adhere to dialogue and consultation." #APEC2026
